message: The other day, we had a storm warning, and my grandkids were buzzing with excitement like it was Christmas morning. I took a deep breath and started gathering flashlights and snacks, while they turned the living room into their very own ‘storm bunker.’ As I watched them, I couldn’t help but chuckle—who knew prepping could be such an adventure? Maybe next time, I’ll let them take the lead on the fun part. After all, if we have to hunker down, we might as well do it with a little flair! 🌪️
